sanskrit: ayaṃ te yonir ṛtviyo yato jāto arocathāḥ | taṃ jānann agna ā roha- -athā no vardhayā rayim ||
english: This is your ritual womb, O Agni, from which, having been born, you shone forth. Knowing it, mount it — then increase our wealth.

sanskrit: pradātāraṃ havāmahe agnim ugram ūtaye | śucir yo vṛtrahantamaḥ ||
english: We invoke the bountiful one, Agni the fierce, for our aid — the pure one who is the mightiest slayer of Vṛtra.

sanskrit: agne acchā vadeha naḥ pratyaṅ naḥ sumanā bhava | pra ṇo yaccha viśāṃ pate dhanadā asi nas tvam ||
english: O Agni, speak forth toward us here; be well-disposed, facing us. Grant us boons, O lord of clans — you are our wealth-giver.

sanskrit: pra ṇo yacchatv aryamā pra bhagaḥ pra bṛhaspatiḥ | pra pūṣā prota sūnṛtā rayiṃ devī dadhātu naḥ ||
english: Let Aryaman grant us, let Bhaga grant us, let Bṛhaspati grant us; let Pūṣan grant us — and may the divine Sūnṛtā bestow wealth upon us.

sanskrit: aryamaṇaṃ bṛhaspatim indraṃ dānāya codaya | vātaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarasvatīṃ savitāraṃ ca vājinam ||
english: Rouse Aryaman, Bṛhaspati, and Indra to give; rouse Vāta, Viṣṇu, Sarasvatī, and Savitār, the prize-winner, to give.

sanskrit: somaṃ rājānam avase 'gniṃ gīrbhir havāmahe | ādityaṃ viṣṇuṃ sūryaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca bṛhaspatim ||
english: We invoke King Soma for aid, and Agni with hymns; we invoke Āditya, Viṣṇu, Sūrya, and Brahmāṇaspati.

sanskrit: indravāyū bṛhaspatiḥ suhaveha havāmahe | yathā naḥ sarvam ij jagat saṅgatyāṃ sumanā asat ||
english: Indra-and-Vāyu and Bṛhaspati — we invoke them here as easy to call, so that at our assembly the whole world may be well-disposed toward us.

sanskrit: tvaṃ no agne agnibhir brahma yajñaṃ ca vardhaya | tvaṃ no deva dātave rayiṃ dānāya codaya ||
english: You, O Agni, augment our brahman-power and sacrifice with the fires; you, O god, impel wealth for us toward bestowal and giving.

sanskrit: vājasyedaṃ prasave saṃbabhūva memā ca viśvā bhuvanāny antaḥ | utāditsantaṃ dāpayati prajānan rayiṃ ca naḥ sarvavīraṃ ni yacchāt ||
english: At the impulsion of the prize-winner this came into being, and within it all these worlds — it compels even the reluctant to give, knowing; and may it bestow on us wealth rich in all heroes.

sanskrit: duhrāṃ me pañca pradiśo duhrām urvīr yathābalam | prāpeyaṃ sarvām ākūtiṃ manasā hṛdayena ca ||
english: May the five directions milk for me, may the broad ones milk for me according to their strength; may I attain every intention with mind and heart.

sanskrit: gosaniṃ vācam udeyaṃ varcasā mābhy ūrṇuhi | ā rundhāṃ sarvato vāyus tvaṣṭā poṣāya dhriyatām ||
english: May I rise with speech that wins cattle; do not cover me over with brilliance. May Vāyu surround me from all sides; may Tvaṣṭṛ be steadied for prosperity.

sanskrit: yata indra bhayāmahe tato no abhayaṃ kṛdhi | maghavañ chagdhi tava tvaṃ na ūtibhir vi dviṣo vi mṛdho jahi ||
english: From whatever we fear, O Indra, from that make us fearless; O Maghavan, be capable — with your aids sunder the enemies, shatter the foes.

sanskrit: indraṃ vayam anūrādhaṃ havāmahe 'nu rādhyāsma dvipadā catuṣpadā | mā naḥ senā araruṣīr upa gur viṣūcīr indra druho vi nāśaya ||
english: We invoke Indra, the granter of success; may we prosper with bipeds and quadrupeds. Let no hostile armies encroach upon us; O Indra, destroy the treacheries scattering in all directions.

sanskrit: indras trātota vṛtrahā paraspā no vareṇyaḥ | sa rakṣitā caramataḥ sa madhyataḥ sa paścāt sa purastān no astu ||
english: Indra is our protector, the slayer of Vṛtra, the guardian of our farthest boundary, the most excellent. May he be our protector from the outermost, from the middle, from behind, and from before.

sanskrit: uruṃ no lokam anu neṣi vidvān svaryaj jyotir abhayaṃ svasti | ugrā ta indra sthavirasya bāhū upa kṣiyema śaraṇā bṛhantā ||
english: Lead us, knowing, into a broad world — the celestial light, freedom from fear, well-being. O Indra, may we dwell under the shelter of your two mighty arms, the arms of the ancient one, the vast shelter.

sanskrit: abhayaṃ naḥ karaty antarikṣam abhayaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe | abhayaṃ paścād abhayaṃ purastād uttarād adharād abhayaṃ no astu ||
english: The atmosphere makes us fearless, both heaven and earth make us fearless; fearlessness behind, fearlessness before — from above and from below, may there be fearlessness for us.

sanskrit: abhayaṃ mitrād abhayam amitrād abhayaṃ jñātād abhayaṃ puro naḥ | abhayaṃ naktam abhayaṃ divā naḥ sarvā āśā mama mitraṃ bhavantu ||
english: Fearlessness from the friend, fearlessness from the foe, fearlessness from the known, fearlessness before us; fearlessness by night, fearlessness by day for us — may all directions become my friend.

sanskrit: jaya prehi māpa krāmaḥ śatrūṇāṃ veda ā khida | indraḥ sapatnahā bhīmaḥ sañjayas te sam ānṛdhat ||
english: Go forward to victory, do not retreat; drive into the rivals' knowledge. Indra the terrible, slayer of rivals, has set victory altogether stirring for you.

sanskrit: tvaṃ jayāsi na parā jayāsā arbheṣv ājau maghavan mahatsu ca | ugraṃ cit tvām avase saṃ śiśīmahe sa tvaṃ na indra havaneṣu mṛḍa ||
english: You shall conquer; you shall not be conquered — in small battles, O Maghavan, and in great ones. We whet even you, the fierce one, for our aid; so, O Indra, be gracious to us in our invocations.

sanskrit: gojitā bāhū asamakratū yudhi karmankarmañ chatamūtī svajaṅkarā | akalpa indro 'pratimānam ojaḥ sa tvaṃ na indra havaneṣu mṛḍa ||
english: His two arms win cattle, matchless in resolve in battle, action after action; of a hundred aids, impetuous by nature — Indra has fashioned unparalleled might. So, O Indra, be gracious to us in our invocations.

sanskrit: vedāham aindraṃ priyam asya śevadhiṃ yad asya nāma guhyaṃ samīke | sa ij jayāti maghavā mamāsaty asmākaṃ yudhmo vihave havaṃ gamat ||
english: I know the dear treasure of Indra, his secret name in the battle; that Maghavan indeed conquers when he is mine — may our warrior come to our invocation in the calling of war.

sanskrit: vayaṃ jayema tvāyujā bhṛto asmākam aṃśam ud avā bharebhare | asmabhyam indra varivaḥ sugaṃ kṛdhi pra śatrūṇāṃ maghavan vṛṣṇiyā ruja ||
english: May we conquer, yoked with you, O sustained one; raise up our share battle by battle. Make wide room and easy passage for us, O Indra; O Maghavan, crush the virile powers of the enemies.

sanskrit: tvāṃ deveṣu prathamaṃ havāmahe tvaṃ babhūvitha pṛtanāsu sāsahiḥ | semaṃ naḥ kārum upamanyum udbhidam indra karāsi prasave rathaṃ puraḥ ||
english: You we invoke first among the gods; you have been the conqueror in battles. This singer of ours — eager, ardent, bursting forth — may you, O Indra, set his chariot foremost at the start.
